name: partner-finance-wlt-readback-cod
executionConcern: Partner WLT wallet, read-only destination, payout eligibility/request, settlement/commission and current COD model reconciliation
objective: Close Partner financial presentation and permitted intents on one WLT-owned money-movement truth, prove destination/payout/unknown-result semantics and remove any obsolete or overlapping Partner COD/finance path.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns wallet/ledger, destination master data, payout eligibility/request state, COD financial truth where applicable, settlement, commission and reconciliation; DSH only exposes bounded trusted operational evidence/facades.

tasks.objective: Prove current Partner finance presentation/readback is one WLT-backed truth
tasks.currentProblem: Current Partner bridge already composes WLT wallet/COD/commission/payout components, but exact-candidate evidence does not yet prove actor isolation, error/partial semantics, no duplicate financial writer, or that every reachable Partner finance route uses the current canonical components.
tasks.requiredChange: Perform complete Partner finance route/component/API caller census; verify current bridge/readback against WLT/DSH contracts; repair only reproduced scope/state/contract defects and remove proven stale/parallel presentation after consumer proof.
tasks.targetState: Every reachable Partner finance entry is coherent, actor-scoped and WLT-backed; missing/error/partial state never fabricates zero or completed financial truth; no DSH/frontend financial owner remains.
tasks.action: Map Partner finance entries and shared consumers; run Partner runtime, DSH finance facade, WLT backend and boundary guards before edits; correct the first authoritative divergence; migrate affected consumers and remove dead/contradictory finance remnants; rerun all invalidated checks.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate authoritative balance/settlement/commission/payout in frontend or DSH.
Do not create a second Partner financial read model.
Do not expose another Partner's financial records or raw destination identifiers.
Do not preserve a proven dead/contradictory finance path merely for unproven compatibility.
Do not broaden independent Captain/Field finance.
acceptanceCriteria: Every live Partner finance entry resolves to current WLT-backed canonical readback.
Cross-Partner read is denied and sensitive destination data remains masked.
Error/empty/partial/unknown states do not fabricate zero or financial completion.
No duplicate/stale Partner financial presentation or authoritative local calculation remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused adapter/presentation change while preserving WLT truth and audit; never restore two financial truths.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Partner finance readback/presentation cleanup commit only after route census and actor-isolation checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close Partner payout destination and FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED request semantics
tasks.currentProblem: PayoutDestinationPanel is substantially aligned with current Product Truth, but UI composition does not prove beneficiary destination mutation is impossible at every route, WLT resolves the current verified destination/eligible amount transactionally, idempotency is payload-safe, or provider_result_unknown remains held through reconciliation.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Partner destination/request APIs through DSH bounded facade to WLT payout/destination/ledger/audit/reconciliation. Verify existing UI first; fix only server/contract/state defects. Remove any beneficiary destination create/update/select route if still reachable under Partner self-service.
tasks.targetState: Partner can only read masked current destination and submit payout intent; WLT chooses current verified destination, resolves FULL_AVAILABLE or validates SPECIFIED, reserves/holds funds atomically, prevents duplicate/divergent replay and exposes canonical pending/unknown/completed state.
tasks.action: Exercise no destination/unverified/verified destination, FULL_AVAILABLE, valid/invalid/excess SPECIFIED, duplicate identical retry, payload-divergent retry, cross-Partner access, provider failure and provider_result_unknown. Reconcile ledger/hold/audit before DONE.
mustNotChange: Do not let Partner create/update/deactivate/select payout destination master data.
Do not send a client-authoritative total for FULL_AVAILABLE.
Do not trust SPECIFIED amount without WLT transactional eligibility validation.
Do not convert unknown provider result to completed locally.
Do not bypass finance permissions/separation-of-duties for destination master data.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner self-service has no destination-master-data mutation path.
FULL_AVAILABLE amount is WLT-derived; SPECIFIED is WLT-validated against current eligibility.
Identical retries are duplicate-safe and divergent replay is rejected where contracted.
provider_result_unknown remains held/auditable/reconcilable until authoritative resolution.
Cross-Partner destination/request access fails without sensitive disclosure.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused Partner payout adapter/domain changes while preserving WLT payout/ledger/reconciliation history; never delete financial evidence.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep payout/destination corrections focused and separate from unrelated COD model migration when practical.

tasks.objective: Resolve Partner COD custody/remit against the current WLT money-movement model
tasks.currentProblem: Partner COD custody/remit UI/routes still exist, but current WLT Product Truth has evolved. Route presence alone does not prove Partner COD remit remains a canonical legal model or that it cannot overlap another order financial effect.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace the exact order/payment/delivery mode that creates Partner COD custody through DSH evidence and WLT COD/ledger state. Decide from current Product Truth/contracts whether the model remains canonical. If current, prove actor/order isolation, legal states, exactly-once effect, cancellation/retry/audit/reconciliation. If superseded/overlapping/dead, migrate callers/data and remove/delegate the obsolete path.
tasks.targetState: Every Partner-visible COD record maps to one explicit current WLT financial model and one order/effect; no duplicate liability, remittance, ledger posting or stale legacy route remains.
tasks.action: Exercise applicable COD creation/collection/remit/retry/cancellation/reconciliation and concurrent replay cases; compare against current order payment allocation/Product Truth; remove overlapping semantics only after caller/data proof; verify Partner and finance-operator canonical readback.
mustNotChange: Do not preserve an obsolete financial model solely because UI/routes exist.
Do not create overlapping WLT/DSH liabilities or duplicate ledger effects for one order value.
Do not accept caller-authoritative financial amount/status.
Do not delete immutable ledger/audit history during model cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner COD model applicability is explicit from current Product Truth/contracts/order state.
One applicable order effect produces at most one canonical WLT financial effect under concurrency/retry.
Illegal/cross-Partner/stale states fail closed and reconciliation/readback agrees with ledger/audit.
Any superseded Partner COD route/component is removed/delegated after caller/data migration proof with no broken imports/contracts.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused model adapter/policy changes while preserving immutable WLT ledger/COD/audit evidence; never reopen duplicate financial paths.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Partner COD model convergence commit after current-model decision and reconciliation evidence pass.
